acceptanceCriteria.criterion: Activity dataclass implemented - Fields: timestamp (datetime), action (str), actor (str - "system" or username), details (Optional[dict])
Session model includes activities list - activities: list[Activity] field, activities persisted in session.yaml
Auto-logged activities for session events - Session created, execution started/completed, comparison started/completed, finding added, finding classified, session resumed, session completed
Manual activity logging supported - session.log_activity(action, message, actor) supports adding notes and custom events
CLI command to view activities - rustybt-validate session activities session_id shows activities in chronological order with format: timestamp | actor | action [details]

doc.title: Product Requirements Document
doc.snippet: NFR25: All discrepancies must be traceable to specific log entries and source code lines. NFR26: All classifications must include timestamps and author. Activities provide audit trail.

doc.title: Architecture Document
doc.snippet: Session metadata in session.yaml. Activities provide audit trail for debugging and compliance. Actor field tracks who/what made changes.

doc.title: Epic 3: Session Management System
doc.snippet: Activity dataclass with timestamp, action, actor, details. Auto-logged for all lifecycle events. Manual logging via log_activity(). Activities append-only (never delete).

doc.title: Story 3.1 - Session Progress Tracking
doc.snippet: update_stage() can trigger activity logging. Stage transitions provide natural logging points.

doc.title: Story 3.2 - Session Resumability
doc.snippet: resume() should log activity. "session_resumed" logged when session resumed from interrupted state.

constraints.constraint: DEPENDS ON Stories 3.1-3.5 - Integrates with all previous session management stories
Activities are append-only - never delete activities
Actor defaults to "system" for automated actions
Store activities in session.yaml (same file as session metadata)
Activity details is Optional[dict] for flexibility

interface.name: Activity
interface.signature: @dataclass class Activity: timestamp: datetime, action: str, actor: str = "system", details: Optional[dict] = None

interface.name: Session.log_activity
interface.signature: def log_activity(self, action: str, message: Optional[str] = None, actor: str = "system") -> None
